name: container-gap
note: @container with an established container: .wrap establishes a container (container-type: inline-size, width 400px), so Chrome's @container (min-width: 100px) matches and paints #child red. Now that layout resolves container sizes, the engine matches the same rule against .wrap's content-box width and paints #child red too. See docs/ledgers/media-queries.md.
